# SENO Avian Genetic Test — aviantestpro.com

> Bird DNA testing laboratory services: avian gender (sex) determination, viral PCR screening, parentage and DNA fingerprinting, plus lab-building and agent programmes. Reports are issued from a molecular diagnostics laboratory with 15 years of experience.

## Core services
- [Avian Gender DNA Test](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-gender-dna-test/): CHD-gene based sex determination from feather, blood or swab samples.
- [Avian Virus RT-PCR Test](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-virus-rt-pcr-test/): Molecular screening for PBFD, avian polyomavirus, PPMV and other avian pathogens.
- [Racing Pigeon Performance DNA Test](https://aviantestpro.com/racing-pigeon-performance-dna-test/): Genetic markers associated with performance traits in racing pigeons.
- [Pigeon DNA Fingerprinting](https://aviantestpro.com/pigeon-dna-fingerprinting/): Individual identity and parentage verification for racing pigeons.
- [Avian DNA Test Kits](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-dna-test-kits/): Sample collection kits for breeders and clinics.
- [Build an Avian DNA Test Lab](https://aviantestpro.com/build-avian-dna-test-lab/): Turnkey laboratory setup and training.
- [Become an Agent](https://aviantestpro.com/become-an-agent/): Regional distribution and referral programme.

## Languages
English, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German — each with its own hreflang-annotated URL prefix (`/ar/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`, `/es/`, `/fr/`, `/de/`).

## Notes
- Results are laboratory reports, not veterinary diagnosis; clinical interpretation belongs to the attending veterinarian.
- Sample collection guidance is published per test; incorrect sampling is the most common cause of an inconclusive result.
